dialogues.speaker: Ding Jr.
dialogues.text: Shhh! Don't let anyone else hear! I'm only telling you, alright!?

dialogues.speaker: Ding Jr.
dialogues.text: There've been more and more Xuanwen Beasts skulking in the mountains lately. A fiend must be behind all this, or something!

dialogues.speaker: Ding Jr.
dialogues.text: If you ask me, the quality of the tea's gone down because these monsters contaminated the water and the soil.
